item.title: Hi, I'm Romeo
item.description: Currently, I am working on certification protocols for machine learning systems in safety-critical domains; first in aerospace, but with future plans for medical, finance, and public policy. To progress with this task, I have been fortunate to join the Stanford Intelligent Systems Lab. If you’re around Stanford and are interested in talking to me, let’s have a coffee! My background is in computational mathematics, both theory and implementation, and mathematical optimization, which I applied to process systems optimization during my time at CMU.
